image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom automotive wheel mounted on a red vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy design with a brushed silver finish on the spokes and a glossy deep red finish on the inner barrel and recessed areas. The center cap displays a yellow shield logo with a black prancing horse (resembling the Ferrari emblem). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread blocks and sidewall texture. The brake caliper and disc are partially visible through the spokes.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white lettering/markings on the tire sidewall are illegible smudges rather than crisp characters. While common in lower-res images, AI often fails to render coherent text here.
The yellow shield logo is slightly soft and lacks the sharp vector-like edges expected of a manufactured emblem, appearing somewhat 'painted on' rather than a physical badge.

The mechanical components visible behind the spokes (brake disc/caliper) lack clear structural definition and appear to merge slightly with the background shadows, a common AI artifact in complex occlusion zones.
